ranked.headline: Learned protein models are scored against physical and experimental references
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify where learned protein and DNA models fail on shallow pockets, disordered sequences and multimeric interfaces.

ranked.headline: New computational frameworks link chromatin looping and methylation to regulatory state
ranked.summary: Harmonized loop calls, calibrated interaction statistics and segmentation models now quantify epigenomic variation across individuals and cells.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and statistical tools reassess multi-omics integration and enrichment methods
ranked.summary: Multi-omics integration does not beat DNA methylation alone in HADACA3 deconvolution, while new enrichment and LLM-assisted tools expand functional analysis.

ranked.headline: Perturbation design and ML priors resolve ambiguity in mechanistic biological models
ranked.summary: Mechanistic signaling and gene regulatory models are being constrained by targeted perturbations and machine-learning-derived priors.

ranked.headline: Functional domains and regulatory programs reframe tumor genome variation effects
ranked.summary: Domain-resolved selection scans and passenger-mutation analyses now link tumor genome variants to functional consequences beyond gene-level association.

ranked.headline: Drug and biomarker models paired with explanations and transfer checks on new data
ranked.summary: Predictive models for binding, toxicity, and survival are increasingly judged on whether their performance holds on new datasets, not only on test splits.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict regulatory and mutational effects across cell types
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence embeddings are now being conditioned on methylation, tissue, and protein-interaction context to predict regulatory and variant effects.

ranked.headline: Methods resolving cell identity from bulk, single-cell, and label-free measurements
ranked.summary: Validation layers for deconvolution and annotation are emerging alongside imaging-based organelle and chromatin classification.

ranked.headline: Transcriptome-scale RNA profiling ties sequence features to regulatory behavior
ranked.summary: Pipelines and benchmarks now test whether sequence-defined RNA features predict interactions, protein binding, and function across species.

ranked.headline: Supervised and expert-curated tools refine immune cell type annotation across modalities
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and expert-guided classifiers refine immune and erythroid cell annotation across cytometry and scRNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: Histology-guided imputation and foundation models predict spatial gene expression
ranked.summary: Foundation models and generative imputation now couple histology with spatial transcriptomics to fill unmeasured genes and spots.

ranked.headline: Unintended ORFs in eGFP constructs and quantified base-editing outcomes in mtDNA
ranked.summary: Sequence-level artifacts and editing outcomes are now measured directly, from plasmid libraries to base-edited mtDNA and Cas9 protospacer screens.

ranked.headline: Learned structure-aware scoring and generation of peptide and epitope candidates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair structure-based epitope prediction, binder design and peptide generation with learned scorers and sparsity-aware or multi-objective…

ranked.headline: Computational methods recover ligands and resolution from cryo-EM and microscopy data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply deep learning, diffusion, and refinement workflows to improve cryo-EM map interpretation and model quality.

ranked.headline: Atomistic simulation maps how ligands and peptides engage their targets
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair structure prediction, molecular dynamics and enhanced sampling to move beyond static poses toward states and energetics.

ranked.headline: Open software standardizes processing of methylation, QTL, and lipidomic datasets
ranked.summary: Accessible software now packages methylation annotation, multi-state QTL analysis, lipidomic processing, and pipeline construction for routine use.

ranked.headline: Computational modeling of protein interaction energetics and conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of coarse-grained potential inference and variant-resolved docking and MD now quantify protein interaction energetics across scales.

ranked.headline: Integrated long-read and k-mer workflows for bacterial and fungal genome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs automated multi-stage pipelines with compact k-mer and embedding methods for microbial sequence data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning infers regulatory structure from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add biological priors to graph and Transformer models for GRN inference and perturbation prediction from scRNA-seq.

ranked.headline: Relational embeddings link spatial niches, RNA velocity, and in-silico perturbation
ranked.summary: Graph and transition models now recover cell-state dynamics and counterfactual responses from snapshot, time-series, and tissue-level single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Computational prioritization and reference-based annotation across omics workflows
ranked.summary: Large, heterogeneous omics search spaces make computational narrowing necessary before targeted experimental or analytical confirmation.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models gain enzyme, expression, and experimental constraints
ranked.summary: Constraint-rich genome-scale models now link enzyme kinetics, gene expression, and growth data to organism-specific metabolism.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link duplication and TE activity to lineage-level genome…
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies across plants, mammals, an octopus and an ant now tie structural change to specific evolutionary mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Accessible tools automate segmentation and quantification across microscopy modalities
ranked.summary: Segmentation and quantification workflows for microscopy are now packaged as laptop, web, and cross-platform applications.

ranked.headline: LLM agents plan and execute bioinformatics workflows over tools, databases and models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair agentic planning with deterministic retrieval, benchmarks and reproducible narratives across genomics and metabolic modeling.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-level inference of introgression and selection from population genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend S*, HMM, and pool-seq selection inference to haplotype blocks, quantile thresholds, and reference-free diploid data.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level genomes for non-model arthropods and a sedaDNA detection benchmark
ranked.summary: Recent releases add chromosome-level and reference genomes for non-model arthropods, and benchmark sedaDNA detection limits for rare vertebrates.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for RAD-seq, multiomic, downsampling and rare-variant analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication present sequencing tools stressing bounded memory, speed, realistic benchmarking and biobank-scale meta-analysis.

ranked.headline: AI-guided selection of drug combinations and signalling perturbations
ranked.summary: Predictive criteria are now being coupled directly into iterative design loops for drug combinations and perturbation screens.

ranked.headline: Error-aware barcode demultiplexing for single-cell and nanopore long-read sequencing
ranked.summary: Nanopore and single-cell long-read workflows increasingly require demultiplexers and error models that tolerate indels, correct barcodes, and handle…

ranked.headline: Differentiation underpins reproducible morphogenesis in multi-scale Cellular Potts model
ranked.summary: Recent models tie differentiation and branching dynamics to reproducible morphogenesis, collective patterning, and neuronal shape across scales.

ranked.headline: Learned models disentangle predictability from regulation in DNA and gene expression
ranked.summary: Recent genomic foundation models and multimodal deep learning now target regulatory variance, miRNA expression, and perturbation response from omics data.

ranked.headline: Phylogenomic and functional surveys map protein family evolution across eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Updated curated domain resources and proteome-scale functional surveys now enable evolutionary inference across 1,000+ proteomes.

ranked.headline: Parameterized models link brain connectivity, gene expression and genetics to AD
ranked.summary: Attribution, generative and unsupervised representation models now extract mechanistic readouts from multimodal AD and brain imaging data.

ranked.headline: Error control and bias correction in parameter, age, and microbial network inference
ranked.summary: Systematic bias and uncontrolled false discoveries distort biological model inference, motivating new uncertainty metrics and corrections.

ranked.headline: Peptide-level proteogenomics links isoform and novel coding models to proteomic evidence
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 items pair top-down proteoform sequencing, customized proteogenomic databases, and isoform-level peptide mapping for protein-level validation.

ranked.headline: Cell-type-resolved regulatory variation nominates effector genes and disease links
ranked.summary: Cell-type context and external anchors such as GWAS loci and trait associations are now used to test variant and gene prioritization.

ranked.headline: Standardized formats and metadata schemas are making biological models and datasets FAIR
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair curation formats and harmonized schemas with large-scale aggregation of single-cell and multi-assay data.

ranked.headline: Interpreting protein language models and forecasting alignment and assay difficulty
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test interpretability methods on protein language models and predict alignment and assay difficulty directly from unaligned sequences.

ranked.headline: Fixed points and cycles in recurrent neural network dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize chaotic, threshold-linear, and harmonic-flow accounts of cyclic structure in neural network dynamics.
